# Highnote Festival

> Annual music and fireworks festival in Epping, NH, benefiting the Adam McPhee Memorial Foundation.

The 26th Annual Highnote Festival takes place every September on the second Saturday of the month, until dark (rain or shine), at the Governor Prescott House, 173 Prescott Road, Epping, NH 03042. Admission is $15 for adults; kids and high school students are free. The event includes live music, family activities, a live auction, fireworks, and a 5k road race in the morning. Proceeds benefit the Adam McPhee Memorial Foundation, which supports inclusion programs and scholarships in Epping, NH.

## Event Details
- [Music and Activities](https://highnotefest.com/#music-activities): schedule of music, wildlife encounters, live auction, fireworks, and activities/exhibits for children and adults
- [Tickets and Directions](https://highnotefest.com/#tickets-directions): ticket pricing and directions to the festival grounds
- [Jack Sharkey 5k](https://highnotefest.com/#five-k): registration and details for the USATF-certified 5k race held the morning of the festival
- [The Adam McPhee Memorial Foundation](https://highnotefest.com/#foundation): background on Adam McPhee and how festival proceeds are used

## Notes
- Festival is held rain or shine; fireworks are weather permitting.
- Pets are not allowed on the grounds for insurance reasons.
- The grounds are handicap accessible.
